verdict.rationale: Trivy ships an official MCP server (trivy-mcp) that integrates its scanning capabilities directly into VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools, including natural-language querying of security issues, which is exactly the wiring an AI coding agent would use to scan AI-generated code before it lands. However, evidence is purely first-party/docs-based with no independent hands-on report of using it as a pre-commit gate for AI-generated code specifically, and no CI/pre-commit hook integration details are shown. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server in an agent workflow, explicit pre-commit/CI wiring examples, and confirmation of real-time blocking before code lands.
